paper_title: SimSMoE Solving Representational Collapse via Similarity Measure
caption: : XMoE Routing Policy

annotations.annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between training steps and bits per character (BPC) during a validation phase. The x-axis represents "Training Steps", expressed in units of 10^3, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 50, and regular tick intervals at every 10 units. The y-axis represents "BPC", also using a linear scale, spanning from 1.25 to 2.25 with tick labels at intervals of 0.25. The plot features two lines. The first line, labeled "XMoE Validating", is yellow with a plus marker and a solid line style. It starts at approximately 2.25 BPC at the left of the x-axis and showing a sharp declining trend till 1.25 at step 10, and showing a steady decline until reaching around 1.10 BPC at the right end of the x-axis. The second line, labeled "SimSMoE Validating", is magenta with a circle marker and also a solid line style. It follows a similar trend, starting around 2.25 BPC and showing a sharp declining trend till 1.27 at step 10, and decreasing to about 1.10 BPC by the end of the x-axis, just below yellow line. Both lines exhibit a decreasing trend across the x-axis, with the majority of the decline occurring within the first 20,000 training steps. A legend is given top right.
